product.title: Incredibilul pelerinaj al lui Harold Fry
product.description: Tulburat de scrisoarea de rămas-bun primită de la Queenie Hennessy, o fostă colegă de serviciu pe care nu o mai văzuse de douăzeci de ani, Harold Fry, un pensionar dintr-un mic oraș din sudul Angliei, iese să pună la poștă câteva rânduri de răspuns. Dintr-un impuls irezistibil și necugetat, pornește însă pe jos către spitalul unde este internată Quennie, convins că aceasta va avea puterea să rămână în viață până la sosirea lui. Fără ghete de drumeție, hartă sau telefon, Harold Fry își începe neobișnuitul pelerinaj preț de opt sute de kilometri, cu credința că prietena lui va continua să trăiască atâta timp cât el continuă să meargă. Timp de optzeci și șapte de zile, traversează Anglia de la nord la sud, purtandu-și crucea ratării și a greșelilor din trecut, în speranța izbăvirii. Ca orice „pelerin“ al căutării de sine, Harold Fry de la începutul romanului nu este același Harold Fry de la sfârșitul lui.

# The Incredible Journey of Harold Fry by Litera Books

Step into the heartwarming and profound world of British fiction with *The Incredible Journey of Harold Fry*. This novel follows a deeply human story of unexpected journeys, life's unintended paths, and the enduring power of connection. If you are looking for a captivating read about self-discovery and resilience, this book is perfect for your next reading adventure.

## Synopsis: A Journey of Faith and Self-Discovery

Harold Fry, a retired gentleman living in a small town in the English countryside, finds his comfortable routine shattered by an unexpected letter from Queenie Hennessy. Queenie is a former colleague he hasn't seen in twenty years, and the initial reason for Harold to write back seems simple: dropping off some correspondence at the post office.

However, an irresistible impulse leads him on a spontaneous journey to visit Quennie in the hospital. Believing that she can only survive as long as he walks, Harold begins an extraordinary pilgrimage. Without hiking boots, a map, or even a phone, he sets out on an unprecedented trek of eight hundred kilometers.

For eighty-seven days, Harold crosses England from north to south. He carries with him not just his walking stick, but the weight of past regrets and mistakes, fueled by the fragile hope that his friend will find salvation through his continuous journey. Like any pilgrim searching for identity, Harold Fry undergoes a profound transformation; he is far from the man who started this epic journey.

## Why Read The Incredible Journey of Harold Fry?

This novel is more than just a story about walkingâitâs an exploration of memory, community, aging, and second chances. Through Harold's incredible trek across England, the author weaves together themes of redemption and friendship, providing readers with a deeply moving experience that celebrates the resilience of the human spirit. It is a beautiful piece of fiction guaranteed to keep you turning pages until the very end.
